answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the vertex of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
